title: Introducing Reflection Beam: an open-weight model for agentic coding on AWS
summary: Reflection 10 月 5 日宣布 Beam 时，权重尚未交付。AWS 10 月 16 日博客确认 Beam 权重已通过 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 发布，BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4 检查点可用；AWS SageMaker JumpStart 先在美国东部两个区域提供部署。
investorNote: 从模型发布声明走到权重与托管部署，是开源模型商业化可用性的实质进展；501B 总参数也意味着较高部署门槛。

fact.subject: AWS
fact.object: Reflection Beam 在 SageMaker JumpStart 的托管部署

evidence.quote: At launch, Beam is available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart in US East (N. Virginia) and US East (Ohio). Reflection’s vision for open intelligence Reflection’s mission is to make intelligence open and accessible to all through open model weights, published research, and open source software. Its full AI stack spans models, core software, production infrastructure, and applications. Beam brings this approach to developers building software engineering and agentic systems. About Reflection Beam Beam is a sparse mixture-of-experts model for resolving software issues, modifying code, calling tools, and acting on intermediate results. It has 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active param

Reflection releases Beam’s weights through Hugging Face under the Apache 2.0 license. Beam 1.0 is available in BF16, FP8, and NVFP4 checkpoint variants. These formats provide different memory footprints and hardware compatibility. You can deploy the model with the AWS managed JumpStart container configuration or inspect and customize the model with SGLang or vLLM in your AWS environment. displayTitle: Beam 权重兑现开放承诺，AWS 同步提供托管部署
narrative: Beam 的新信息是交付：此前 Reflection 只宣布模型并预告权重，本次 AWS 确认权重已在 Hugging Face 以 Apache 2.0 许可发布，且 SageMaker JumpStart 在美国东部两区上线。模型有 5010 亿总参数、230 亿激活参数，部署仍需多 GPU。开放权重和托管入口同时到位，降低了试用与定制门槛，但公开模型不等于低成本自托管。

eventRelation.reason: 10月5日只宣布模型并预告随后开放权重；本次是权重实际发布与AWS上线部署入口
eventRelation.newInformation: Beam权重以Apache 2.0在Hugging Face交付，AWS在美东两区提供JumpStart部署
